messages:
taylor_p: Heads-up  planning thread: want to align on delivery windows for H100/H200/B200, MI300, Gaudi; SI enablement timeline; marketplace SKU mapping; and embargo windows. Please drop exact dates and any hard constraints.

lee_pm: Marketing needs embargo constraints asap. Also need a short feature matrix for marketplace copy (max 3 bullets per HW). Can we get that by Apr 26?

sophia_partnerships: From partnerships: NVIDIA H100->H200 uplift plan: partner GA May 6, but early validation boards available Apr 24. B200 (in-market ASIC) lagging a week behind H200.

nvidia_partner: Confirming early validation drop to Redwood lab on 2026-04-24. We require a signed transfer form and the Redwood lab to enable secure wipe policy on return. Embargo: no joint announcement before May 7.

gaudi_hw: Gaudi timeline: partner preview hardware ships Apr 30, general availability May 12. Note: Gaudi firmware v2.1 required for our nvlink-equivalent; ask eng to verify driver syscall surfaces.

devin_eng: Noted. We'll need sample kernel boot logs and a small repro to validate the firmware/syscall mismatch. Which repo should we push logs into?

sophia_partnerships: Use private s3 bucket (partners.redwood.net/gaudi-logs) until we've sanitized. I'll share link + short ACLs.

marketplace_ops: SKU/region note: Marketplace SKU template needs CPU/GPU SKU mapping, supported regions list, and a recommended instance size. Can infra provide a default SKU by Apr 25?

deploy_bot: infra-bot: Reserved validation cluster (2 racks) 2026-04-24 -> 2026-04-29; network ACL flagged: partner-sdks allowlist required.

devin_eng: For tests, will run: driver smoke (boot, mem), perf fingerprint (p95 latency, throughput), quantized int8 accuracy delta, KV-cache stress (4k/32k contexts), and multi-node nvlink tests for B200. Anything else?

lee_pm: Also include a short "known-limits" line for marketing: e.g., max context tested, regions, and recommended instance sizes. Keep 1-liners.

nvidia_partner: One more ask: please ensure telemetry opt-in is explicit. We can only accept pre-GA diagnostics if customers opt in.

devin_eng: We'll make telemetry opt-in default off, with instructions in the runbook for enabling.

gaudi_hw: Also flag cooling/power: Gaudi boards have 700W peak. Confirm lab rack PDUs can handle sustained draw.

deploy_bot: infra-bot: Rack power check passed for 2 racks (N+1 PDUs), but recommend staggered burn-in to avoid tripping breakers.

sophia_partnerships: SI integration windows: propose a 90-min enablement session Apr 28 (deep-dive + hands-on). Who from eng can present?

devin_eng: I can present the runtime differences and common gotchas. Will prepare a 2-slide TL;DR + a 10-step quickstart for SI. Need slides by Apr 26.

lee_pm: Can we also lock the embargo to May 8 public announcement? Nvidia earlier asked May 7, but prefer May 8 to allow press outreach. Are partners okay?

nvidia_partner: May 8 is acceptable if our internal partner comm is complete on May 6.

gaudi_hw: Fine with May 8. MI300 partner plan expects May 10 GA public but we can list "coming soon" with supported models.

sophia_partnerships: Action items summary:
- nvidia_partner: confirm board shipping manifest + transfer form (due Apr 20)
- gaudi_hw: firmware notes + power/thermal guidance (due Apr 22)
- devin_eng: test matrix + 1-pager SI quickstart + slides (due Apr 26)
- marketplace_ops: placeholder SKU + regions list (due Apr 25)
- sophia_partnerships: S3 ACLs + invite for Apr 28 SI session (due Apr 21)
- deploy_bot/infra: staggered rack burn-in schedule + PDU confirmation (due Apr 23)

lee_pm: Meeting: propose Apr 27 09:30am PT for final go/no-go on lab validation and assets. If we can't finish, we shift embargo later.

taylor_p: I'll schedule Apr 27 09:30am PT. Please add calendar conflicts here. Also tagging legal for transfer form review: @legal-team.

legal-team: legal-bot: Received. We'll review transfer + NDA addendum and revert by Apr 21.

marketplace_ops: One more question: for billing SKU, do you want separate SKUs for H200 vs B200? Typically customers select by GPU family; we can map to a single "H-class" SKU if preferred.

sophia_partnerships: Let's map H200/B200 to separate SKUs due to different perf tiers and pricing. Marketplace Ops please provide pricing template.

lee_pm: Small marketing ask: provide 2-3 customer scenarios where H200/H100 falls back and what cost trade-offs are; we'll put that in the announcement FAQ. Can eng draft a short blurb?

devin_eng: I'll draft a 2-paragraph FAQ blurb: fallback policy, perf vs cost, and quantization guidance. Due Apr 26.

lee_pm: Great. Thanks everyone. Keep updates in-thread. If critical delays hit, ping me and sophia directly. :thumbsup:
